Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u001/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6f44070e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    centers = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if (grid[r - 1][c] == 2 and grid[r + 1][c] == 2 and
                grid[r][c - 1] == 2 and grid[r][c + 1] == 2 and
                grid[r][c] == 0):
                centers.append((r, c))
    # Join consecutive diamond centers in each shared row or column.
    for r, c in centers:
        same_row = sorted(x for y, x in centers if y == r)
        same_col = sorted(y for y, x in centers if x == c)
        if c in same_row:
            i = same_row.index(c)
            if i + 1 < len(same_row):
                for x in range(c + 2, same_row[i + 1] - 1):
                    if out[r][x] == 0:
                        out[r][x] = 1
        if r in same_col:
            i = same_col.index(r)
            if i + 1 < len(same_col):
                for y in range(r + 2, same_col[i + 1] - 1):
                    if out[y][c] == 0:
                        out[y][c] = 1
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
